messages:
mira: quick intake for Orchid-20b bring-up — proposing prioritization for perf + quant + quality. want to triage: 1) baseline fp16 perf, 2) int8 quant smoke, 3) int4 exploratory (low priority), 4) quality regression set run.

mira: suggested sweeps: ctx [2048, 4096, 8192, 32768], batch [1,4,8], token-length dist to mimic chat vs long-doc. target: p50 latency <300ms @ batch=1 for 4096 if possible, and throughput curves for batch=4/8.

lee: +1. can we also capture KV-cache warmup (cold vs warm start)? add 50-request warmup then measure steady-state.

tj: ok. for quant: run QAT? not now — do static int8 first with per-channel scales. record perplexity on eval set and compare to fp16. int4 only if int8 cost savings insufficient.

sam: who owns the quality eval set? we need prompt slices: summarization, instruction-following, multi-turn chat, code completion. and hallucination heuristics. i can assemble ~200 examples if that's fine.

mira: that'd be great sam — aim for 50 per slice. include the latest regression prompts from weekly-evals. add edge-cases (long context ref resolution).

tj: bench job config i usually run:```bash
run_bench --model orchid-20b --precision fp16 --ctx 4096 --batch 1 --warmup 50 --steps 200 --profile tokens_per_sec,latency
run_bench --model orchid-20b --precision int8 --ctx 4096 --batch 1 --warmup 50 --steps 200 --profile tokens_per_sec,latency
```
Please attach the raw JSON perf outputs and a short summary.

bench-bot: scheduled bench run for Orchid-20b (fp16) on node pool `perf-ortho` at 2025-11-05T09:00Z. job_id: bench-oa-1750009. will post results when done. :robot_face:

ops: note — if int8 push needs new kernels we should flag eng-runtime early. provide model repo link and quant artifacts. ops will reserve a slot for int8 runs next week.

lee: on rollout priorities: 1) perf baseline + warmup behaviour, 2) int8 smoke + PPL delta, 3) quality pass on 200 examples, 4) cost/throughput recommendation and routing profile. can we aim for a first-pass report within 5 business days after fp16 bench completes?

mira: yes that's the plan. blockers: model shard layout unknown (need model repo), and early tokenizer quirks (we saw merge token differences with other 20b models). sam can you confirm tokenization parity?

sam: I'll run tokenization diff against reference tokenizer and post results. also will add a small script for mapping off-by-one splits.

tj: one more: include an adversarial short prompt set for safety/regression (to check prompt injection). we should baseline safety filters.

mira: agreed. i'll create a tracking doc and ping people. tracking checklist (short):
- model repo link (required)
- baseline fp16 perf (bench-bot)
- int8 smoke (ops + eng-runtime aware)
- int4 exploratory (optional)
- quality evals (sam)
- KV warmup vs steady-state analysis (lee)
- regression delta report (PPL, exact-match, rouge, subjective notes)
- cost per 1M tokens estimates (redwood units)

mira: tagging assignees: @sam quality set, @lee warmup + perf graphs, @tj quant config + PPL deltas, @ops reserve infra. anything else?

lee: we should also capture memory & OOM logs for long ctx (32k). add `dmesg` and runtime OOM flags to the bench job.

bench-bot: ack — added extra logging flags to job bench-oa-1750009. will attach `dmesg.txt` + `profiling.json` on completion.
